claims.claim: Personal Gmail accounts have a 25 MB attachment limit.
claims.qualification: Google Workspace administrators set work and school attachment limits. The limit is for total attachment size, not each individual file.
claims.title: Send attachments with your Gmail message
claims.source_date: Current product documentation; no publication date shown
support: For personal Gmail accounts, the limit is 25 MB
claims.excerpt: For personal Gmail accounts, the limit is 25 MB.

claims.claim: When total attachments exceed the applicable limit, Gmail adds a Google Drive link instead.
claims.qualification: Recipients still need the relevant Drive access. This is Gmail behavior, not an endorsement or affiliation.
claims.title: Send attachments with your Gmail message
claims.source_date: Current product documentation; no publication date shown

claims.claim: Dropbox shared-link restrictions apply to that link; people with existing direct access keep their permissions.
claims.qualification: The documented advanced link options are limited to specified Dropbox paid plans. Direct membership permissions must be managed separately.
claims.title: How to set or change shared link permissions
claims.excerpt: Anyone added directly, or who already has access, keeps their existing permissions
